----Petitioners  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Sangeeta D/o Durg Singh, R/o 130, Meera Nagar,
 Jhalamand Circle, Jodhpur  ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ashok Choudhary For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mohd. Javed Gori, P.P.
 Mr. N.S. Rajpurohit  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN MONGA Order (Oral) 11/07/2024 1.

Instant Criminal Misc. Petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for compromise quashing of F.I.R.
No.23/2018 dated 05.02.2028 lodged at Mahila Police Station Jodhpur West for offences under Sections 498A, 406 of IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in view of the compromise between the parties,
respondent No.2-complainant is not inclined to press charges against the petitioner and proceed further in the matter.
Learned counsel places reliance on a decision of Supreme Court in the case of Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab & Anr. [(2012) 10 SCC 303].

entities.text: Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab & Anr. [(2012) 10 SCC 303]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He urges that the [2024:RJ-JD:28348]
(2 of 2) [CRLMP-4439/2024] impugned FIR and all consequential proceedings may be quashed on the basis of compromise.

3. Learned counsel for the respondent No.2-complainant and learned Public Prosecutor concur with the fact of compromise and submit that in view of the compromise, they have no objection if the FIR in question is quashed.

entities.text: Surendra Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:28348)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the premise, applying the ratio in decision of Gian Singh (Supra), I deem it just and proper to invoke inherent powers of this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C to avoid undue hardship to the parties.

5. Accordingly, the present misc. petition is allowed and the F.I.R. No.23/2018 dated 05.02.2028 lodged at Mahila Police Station Jodhpur West for offences under Sections 498A, 406 of IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act against the petitioner is hereby quashed.
6. Stay petition is also decided accordingly.

(ARUN MONGA), J 63-AnilKC/-
